newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grand Casinos starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grand Casinos starts as buy.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Grand Casinos Inc with a buy recommendation.
--Its EPS estimates on the casino company are $0.85 for 1996 and $2 for 1997.
--In a report, Dain said it expects Grand Casinos to release Q3 earnings next week that could be higher than its $0.08 per share estimate.

--It said Grand Casino shares are trading at a significant discount to its peer group with a P/E of 8.3 times 1997 earnings, or discounts of 52.7 percent to large casinio companies and 35 percent to small casino companies.
